title: 5 Undervalued Stocks to Buy Now in November (2026)
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA presents five stocks he considers undervalued for November 2026, all rated BUY. Monday.com is a first tracked call, with a fair value of $121 against just under $100, about 22% upside over 12-18 months, on the view that software-as-a-service sell-off fears are overblown and the shares have recovered from the February SaaS rout. AppLovin is a reiterated BUY, fair value $354 against $263, about 35% upside, despite sitting near its 52-week low after revenue missed guidance and costs rose. Celsius is a reiterated BUY, fair value $43 against $28, about 55% upside, with energy drinks gaining beverage share and international growth still early-stage, though SKU cuts went too far and hurt sales. Chewy is a first tracked call, fair value $33, about 53% upside, praised as a well-managed online pet retailer that handled both the pandemic boom and reopening prudently by improving logistics rather than over-expanding. Chipotle flips from HOLD on 10 October to BUY, fair value $33.50 against $28 near its 52-week low, about 20% upside, performing relatively well despite restaurant-industry strain from tariffs, oil and insurance costs.
